source_title: G Flip and Chrishell Stause Split: A Timeline of Their Relationship
source_excerpt:
G Flip and Chrishell Stause’s relationship has reached the end of the road after more than four years together. The couple announced their separation through social media statements. Flip opted for a written statement, sharing, “My head & heart are feeling very heavy right now and I’m not able to talk but I want to thank you all for your support and appreciate you respecting our privacy at this difficult time.”
Stause, who used to star in the reality series Selling Sunset, addressed the split in a video shared with her followers. “We have agreed to treat this public separation with love and respect for each other,” she said. “That’s not hard for me because I am in love with this person, and I don’t have all the information or the reasons.” Neither Stause nor Flip go into deeper detail about the split, but note they will always love each other.
Here’s a timeline of their romance from start to end.
Flip and Stause were introduced to each other in 2021 by Tones And I, the singer behind “Dance Monkey.” “Aesthetically, we just seem like an odd pairing, but when we really got to know each other’s personalities, we are so similar,” Flip told Rolling Stone in 2023, just a few months after they married Stause. “Which people on the outside would be like, ‘What the fuck?’”
May 2022: They Confirm Their Relationship
The couple reportedly reconnected at the beginning of the year and started hanging out. Eventually, they started a relationship, which Strause confirmed on the reunion of Season Five of Selling Sunset .
“You don’t get to choose where you meet someone. You don’t get to choose when you meet someone in their life,” Stause said during the reunion show.
2022: Strause Stars In G Flip’s Music Video
Reportedly, G Flip asked Stause to be in the music video for their song “”Get Me Outta Here” after the pair reconnected in 2022. The video came out in May, after Strause had confirmed the relationship, and instantly got people talking. It was surprisingly steamy and showed them fully making out and flirting in a convenience store and in a bright red studio. “We actually didn’t meet on the set of my music video, which has been written about quite a bit,” G Flip told PAPER . “I first met Chrishell last year in October. We had been hanging out and naturally we would speak about our work lives and what we had coming up. Talking about the music video for a song I was gonna release in the future called ‘GET ME OUTTA HERE,’ Chrishell gave me ideas for the visuals and then actually came up with the creative for it, which very much highlights her talents.
May 2023: They Share the Screen on Selling Sunset
On the 2022 Selling Sunset reunion, Strause had shared how much G Flip meant to her. “I recently have been spending a lot of time with someone that’s very important to me. Their name is G Flip,” she told host Tan France and her fellow castmates. “They’re non-binary so they go by they/them. And they are an extremely talented musician.”
So it made perfect sense when Flip appeared in Season 6 of the reality series, and Status continued to gush about their relationship. The musician went onto appear in Season 7, 8, and 9 until Stause’s exit from the show. In Season 8, the pair even gave viewers a glimpse into their journey of starting a family.
“I’m like, ‘Baby, in the end, this is just a small part of your life. When you come back home it’s chill. We can digest and work through it.’ I definitely think I’m a calming presence in her life, for sure,” Flip told RS in 2023. They also emphasized their hope non-binary feel seen with their appearance. “To have representation where we could just easily display our love and that could change someone’s life … It might start a conversation about what it is to be non-binary… That was something I was deprived of as a kid,” they said. Flip and Stause leveled up their relationship after dating for just over a year. The pair tied the knot in Las Vegas of all places, and were even officiated by an Elvis impersonator. Stause shared the news with an Instagram highlight reel of the pair’s most romantic moments over the months soundtracked by “Be Your Man,” a song Flip wrote for her. “Love doesn’t always go as planned… Sometimes it’s immeasurably better,” she wrote in the caption.
The Vegas ceremony wasn’t legally binding, as TMZ , promptly pointed out — and recently reported as a reminder. But even though they didn’t ink their names on a document, the pair later revealed that they got parts of their vows tattooed on each other. In July 2024, they renewed those same vows during a private ceremony in Australia. A few months after the ceremony, Flip opened up about married life to People , “It’s great,” they said. “We adore each other and we’re having so much fun … We have anniversaries for everything,” they continued. “Actually, last week was the anniversary of the first time we kissed, so that was cute. So we have lots of cute little anniversaries, but we always do something special. We like to go on little trips.”
Strause went on Instagram and shared a heartbroken update on Oct. 26, announcing the couple decided to split after three years of marriage. “I have a pretty humbling update to share with you guys. G and I are no longer together, and we have agreed to treat this public separation with love and respect for each other,” she said. She implied she wasn’t sure why the break-up was happening but thanked fans for their support. “I’m sure, just like always, with time, you know, you get the lessons you’re meant to get,” she said. “And I know that will happen and I’m gonna heal and everything’s gonna be fine. I’m definitely never doing this again. But I just felt like you guys deserved a little bit more than a cold written statement because you have been so supportive and so loving. A few days after Strause’s video, G Flip addressed the break-up themselves. ““After 4+ years Chrishell and I are no longer together,” they wrote on Instagram on Oct. 26. “I will always love her, we will always share a special connection and I cherish our memories together deeply.”
They shared that the break-up has been an emotional moment. “My head & heart are feeling very heavy right now and I’m not able to talk,” G Flip wrote. “But I want to thank you all for your support and appreciate you respecting our privacy at this difficult time.”
